body:
This was my first time using any research chemical. Ive heard and read about AMT/5 MEO, supposidly very simaler to acid. After looking for acid for about 2 years and no luck, out of nowhere i get a call from my friend B saying he can get AMT.(where i live, its basically herb and yae).
2 or 3 days later i get a call from the guy, and decided i might as well run the mission now and get the shit. it was at a good price ($10 for 1 8mg cap) and i bought 3, 1 for me and a friend, 1 for 2 other friends, and an extra one 'just in case'.
I called K up (B's girl, they live together) and said i got it, so i headed over because they wanted to see it. It was an off-white powder, mostly sticking to the inside of the cap. just for the hell of it i decided to use some of the 3rd cap and powder up a bowl of herb with it. I didnt think it was a good idea at all, but it was my idea so fuck it. it DEFINENTLY added to the weed, a slight euphoric/stimulated effect to it, and some visual distortions. Irritated my lungs a little tho...
So the day after that we (me, B, K, and C) all decided to trip on this shit. The doses where roughly 4 mg each, and i was very excited. not counting a morning glory trip(wich is another story alltogether), and a 1.5g shroom trip, this was basically my first time. Unfortunitaly, me and C didnt trip at all. We felt effects, but no visuals. Throuought the 'trip' we where smoking alot of bud, wich at least made it better. It was simaler to comming up on a roll. B was 'sort of' trippin, and K was trippin all kinds of balls.
the next day it turned out that B didnt enjoy his trip, and K got bored of it after a while, since she couldnt get to sleep.(none of us could). I was pissed as fuck, after all that anticipation, then it turns out to be bullshit.
Its not like i had a bad time, but i was supposed to trip and i didnt, wich is dissapoiinting. i was hoping to finally trip, but i guess ill have look harder.
peace
